note: Work: the Labour Law No. (7) of 2000, article 93: children may not be employed before fifteen; article 1 defines a juvenile (حدث) as one who has reached fifteen and not passed eighteen; juveniles need a medical check before work and every six months (article 94); hazardous work, night work and hours limits for juveniles (articles 95 to 99) aren't held. The Law makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below fifteen (my reading). Read from the Ministry of Health's PDF copy of the Law (its text layer renders some Arabic letters in presentation forms, as quoted); An-Najah University's Maqam encyclopedia gave articles 92 and 100 but not 93. Majority: which law sets it in the West Bank and in Gaza (the Jordanian and Egyptian-era civil laws still applied, and the Child Law of 2004 defining a child as under eighteen) wasn't read; left null. Service: Palestine has no armed forces calling anyone, but no source saying so was read; left null.
